market_question: Will Yang Seung-jo win the 2026 Chungcheongnam Province gubernatorial election?
reasoning: Yang Seung-jo is a former governor of the province and, if he runs, could be a competitive candidate especially if the Democratic Party gains momentum after the 2025 presidential election. Even accounting for his 2022 loss as incumbent, a 0.8% implied probability sharply underestimates the chance he secures the nomination and wins a single election a year away.
evidence_points: Former governor with high name recognition
Possible Democratic Party tailwinds from national politics
Implied probability far below typical tail-risk estimates for a figure of his stature
sources_consulted: General knowledge of South Korean politics
